correct.evidence: Every SPEC input, checked by hand against the saved words, is right: opt.last_day 2026-10-17 to 2027-03-16 for program end 2027-01-15, prepare 2026-09-17, new plan 2026-08-13, limit day 2026-12-27. Beside them: a STEM card with no employer drops both new-employer windows (blocking 1), and a card that starts after today gets limit_day null where 2027-01-12 is due.

sourced.evidence: Every value used matches its saved quote, status and regime, and the prepare setting is never under rule_ids. The opt_job_start reading is not marked (reading false), and CHANGELOG.md:250 still calls the dso_on member skipped.

never_assumes.evidence: Blocking 1: a2 with no employer, w2 with e2 from 2026-08-03. There is no stem_job_start stage and no question, and no reason names a2.employer. dso_on, w.employer and card_start are each asked when missing.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: The labels name dates only, and prepare labels say 'a planning date'. limit_day carries no words. The working shown for opt.prepare.opens.a2 (program end and the 90-day rule) gives 2025-09-14, not the 2025-08-14 shown, because the setting is not in inputs.

secure.evidence: A pack naming an unknown setting id loads and then raises SettingsError on every compute. A non-date setting unit gives a quiet null opens. The overflow at card_end 9999-12-31 was already there at 5cd505c. Bounded spans compute in 0.03 s.

tested.evidence: Seven mutants: five caught (limit index, item and upcoming planning, setting sign, the new-employer filter). M7 (drop the during-STEM filter) and M5 (report from new_plan rule) survive. No test covers blocking 1.

findings.title: STEM card with no employer drops the new-employer windows and asks nothing
findings.input: test_a_new_employer_during_stem_gives_the_new_plan_window's case with employer removed from a2; w1 e1 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-02, w2 e2 from 2026-08-03; today 2026-09-29
findings.what_happens: No stem_job_start stage, no new_plan or report window, no question for a2.employer, and no reason names it. With employer e1 the windows are 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-13. differs_from on a missing field is unknown, and run_stages reads the unknown selection as [] and drops its trace.

findings.title: planning date's working leaves out the setting
findings.what_happens: inputs {p1.end_date: 2025-12-13} and rule_ids [opt.apply_before_days] give 2025-09-14, but the value is 2025-08-14. How Duly counted shows no setting. Put plan.prepare_months and its value in inputs.

findings.title: no limit day for a card that has not started
findings.what_happens: limit_day is null; if nothing changes the count reaches 90 on 2027-01-12. Null also stands for never reached and not known.

findings.title: STEM report window and during-STEM filter untested
findings.input: mutant M7 removes parameters.yaml:2058; mutant M5 dates stem_job_start.report from stem.new_plan_due_days
findings.what_happens: Both pass every W2 unit and holdout test. Under M7, a new-employer job begun before the STEM card gets a new I-983 window.

findings.title: unknown setting id loads, then compute raises
findings.input: toy pack window opens {setting: no.such.setting, sign: -1}; or {setting: loop.weekly_budget}
findings.what_happens: validate_pack accepts both. Compute raises SettingsError on the first, and gives opens null with no reason on the second.

findings.title: job-start report is a reading shown as verbatim
findings.what_happens: The CHANGELOG calls 'a new job is a change in employment information' a reading, but the items carry reading false.

findings.title: CHANGELOG contradicts the founder fix
findings.what_happens: It says the recommendation member is 'skipped while dso_on is not entered'. Since c24c65d it is required and asked.

findings.title: setting looked up twice
findings.what_happens: next(...) scans settings again for the unit after whole_setting scanned it for the value. engine/settings.py could return both.

findings.title: last-day window carries an opens item under 'Last day' words
findings.what_happens: It reads 'Last day to file Form I-765: opens Sep 14, 2025', and upcoming lists opt.last_day.opens beside opt.apply_window.opens.

findings.title: limit-day words test is vacuous
findings.what_happens: The item has no words, so the test reads only id, unit and status.

findings.title: early recommendation gives an inverted last-day window
findings.what_happens: Opens 2026-02-14 and closes 2026-02-01. opt_post.filed_in_window already raises a conflict.

findings.title: job-start row marked Done by date alone
findings.input: a work record with no employer_reported, window passed
findings.what_happens: The stage state is done once its window has passed, as opt_job_end already does.
